sentences.text: Elrhazosaurus is a genus of basal iguanodontian dinosaur.
This lightly built herbivore likely moved rapidly on two legs.
Peter Galton and Philippe Taquet first described the fossil as a new species of Valdosaurus in 1982.
Peter Galton later reclassified the species into its own genus, Elrhazosaurus, in 2009.
The dinosaur is classified within the family Dryosauridae.
Peter Galton retained the classification of Elrhazosaurus as a dryosaurid.
The dinosaur lived in the middle of the Cretaceous period, approximately 115 million years ago during the Aptian, in what is now Africa.
The genus lived between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago during the Aptian stage.
